name: rhema-infra-pulumi
description: Pulumi (TypeScript) GCP program for Rhema (spec §13.2). Operator-run IaC — NOT a pnpm-workspace member; the Pulumi CLI installs these deps at `pulumi up` time, mirroring how the old SST config was CLI-run. Imports the pure, dependency-free stage facts directly from ../config/*.ts.
//versions: Pinned to the versions the program was typechecked clean against (offline validation of the IaC).
